title: Refine implicit-surface weights with chain-aware influence domains
description:
## Summary
Refine the MVP welded-surface weighting model with explicit anatomical influence domains.

## Current state
The domain-aware refinement is implemented. `InfluenceDomain[]` is supplied by the live runtime preview to `CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer.Bind`; Body radius preparation now uses the compact anatomical Body rig. The compact-rig topology dependency is resolved.

## Acceptance
Preserve TSK-0131 closest-segment distance, morphology radii, deterministic top-four selection, normalization, mirror behavior, and build-time ownership. Prove hip, shoulder, mirrored, branch, knee, and elbow locality plus generated-geometry deformation.

## Remaining gate
Executable Unity generated-geometry validation is still required. The task must not be marked Done based solely on source/build inspection. Foot-grounding remains separate.

## Evidence
See the skeleton/animation audit documents under `docs/audits/` on `audit/skeleton-animation-improvements-2026-09-07`.
